# Open source used by Skeptic

| Library | Version | License | What it does here |
|---|---|---|---|
| WebLLM by MLC AI | 0.2.84 | Apache 2.0 | Runs a language model on the visitor's device with WebGPU |
| Qwen3.5 models by Alibaba Cloud | 0.8B, 4B, 9B | Apache 2.0 | The model weights downloaded from Hugging Face for the on device option |
| marked | 18.0.14 | MIT | Turns chat replies written in markdown into HTML |
| DOMPurify by Cure53 | 3.4.16 | Apache 2.0 or MPL 2.0 | Cleans that HTML so nothing in a reply can run code |
| Papa Parse | 5.5.3 | MIT | Reads messy CSV files |
| highlight.js | 11.11.1 | BSD 3 Clause | Colors code in replies and the code panel |
| PDF.js by Mozilla | 6.3.289 | Apache 2.0 | Reads text out of PDF files |
| read-excel-file | 9.3.10 | MIT | Reads Excel files |
| supabase-js | 2.117.2 | MIT | Sign in and sync, when turned on |

Full license texts are in each project's repository.
